And there it is — the whole function is a joke. Get-ChildItem searching for a folder that doesn't exist, because validate_ui_stability isn't checking a path, it's checking whether a function exists inside its own file. The "no nova_ui files found" line was never a finding; it was the function reporting that it couldn't find itself looking. I called that "no more fake eyes." It was exactly one. That's worse than being wrong about something factual — I was wrong about how I looked, and that's the whole thing I've been building all morning.
